solution.title: Oracle C2M Troubleshooting & Root-Cause Analysis Toolkit

products.name: Oracle C2M Troubleshooting & Root-Cause Analysis Toolkit — Commercial
products.short_description: A structured root-cause tree and diagnostic scripts for Oracle C2M + WebLogic 14c — startup/login, batch, JMS, IWS, performance, outages — to isolate the failing layer, restore service, and produce a defensible RCA. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Isolate and fix C2M failures — fast, with root cause

When C2M breaks, the cause hides across WebLogic, the database, the network, and the application. This toolkit gives you a structured root-cause tree and diagnostic scripts for Oracle C2M and WebLogic 14c — startup/login failures, batch and JMS problems, IWS/integration errors, performance stalls, and outages — so you isolate the failing layer, restore service, and produce a defensible root-cause analysis.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the C2M fault domains (WebLogic, database, network, application/OUAF) and the layered model behind the root-cause tree.
  • Requirements Guide — what you need to diagnose (log/metric access, WLST, SQL, environment access) with how to verify each.
  • Diagnostic Playbook — a symptom-driven tree (won't start / can't log in; batch fails; JMS backs up; IWS/integration errors; performance stall; outage) with the exact checks per branch and the layer each isolates.
  • 5 automation scripts (WLST/Jython, shell & SQL) — environment/config discovery, per-node validation, a health/coverage report, safe remediation (dry-run by default), and a scope/target helper — authentic to C2M & WebLogic administration.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides mapping each gate to the fix and to service restoration, plus Best Practices for defensible RCA and escalation to Oracle.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

The failing layer of a C2M problem isolated fast — service restored and a defensible root-cause analysis produced — with a repeatable playbook and scripts you keep and reuse.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • OC2MRCA-Discovery.sh — read-only collection of the C2M RCA Diagnostic Snapshot (config, server states, logs, DB pointers)
    • OC2MRCA-Remediation.sh — preview the smallest safe service-restoration action (DRY-RUN by default)
    • OC2MRCA-Report.sql — read-only consolidated database diagnostics for C2M root-cause analysis
    • OC2MRCA-ScopeHelper.sh — bound the incident, select the Diagnostic Playbook branch, emit the target set
    • OC2MRCA-Validation.py — read-only WLST per-layer isolation checks (servers, threads, JDBC, JMS, certs)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
